title: Italian Tunnel and Cellar
preview: Enter a cooler, quieter part of Mylotopi. The tunnel and cellar connect stone, wine and the more hidden history of the 1940s.
details: As you step underground, notice the temperature, the curve of the walls and the way sound changes inside the stone passage.
Today, the cellar presents wine and atmosphere as part of the Mylotopi experience. The cool stone setting also reminds visitors that the same space once belonged to a different moment in history.

items.label: Cool stone
items.text: The tunnel changes the pace of the visit through temperature, sound and enclosure.

items.label: Wartime shelter
items.text: In the 1940s, the passage was connected with Italian soldiers and the needs of defense.

items.label: Wine cellar
items.text: The same space now holds hospitality, wine and atmosphere.

items.label: Strong contrast
items.text: The route leads from protection and defense back toward food, welcome and the view over Kefalos.

details: When you leave the tunnel, continue toward the traditional house and bakery to return to the domestic life of the old village.
